about: USB and line input in three states: loopback as stock, wet+dry with the return kept out of USB main, and wet with USB main carrying the dry synth alone, an insert. With the amp engine its sound is the return. A click of the blue knob on the input screen steps them; a click of the gray knob keeps the speaker on with a cable in. Needs the base (base.pack) and nothing else.
name: loopback
